DEMO.title: Demo Systems reports quarterly results and raises guidance
DEMO.text_excerpt: Demo Systems reports quarterly results and raised guidance after revenue grew well above prior expectations. Management described durable demand, a larger order backlog, improved margins, and a higher full-year outlook. The company reported earnings per share above consensus and increased its revenue forecast. Executives said the change reflects signed customer demand rather than a one-time benefit. The release includes reconciled results, detailed segment revenue, and the assumptions behind the new full-year guidance.
